x = 1
x = 2
y = 3
y = x + 1
run { a = x + 1  b = a * 2  c = b + y }
run { a = 5  b = a + x }
run { d = y * 2  e = d + x  f = e + 1 }
run { d = 7  e = d * 0 + 3  f = e + x }
run { global g = x * 3  h = g + 1 }
print a
print b
print c
print e
print f
print g
z = c + f
print z
{ x = 9  run { g = x + 1  h = g + y }  print h }
global y = 7
w = h + 1
print w
run { k = [x, y]  m = k }
print k
run { a = x * 0 + 4  b = a + 1  c = b * 2 }
run { a = y - y  b = a + 2  c = b + 1 }
run { e = x * 0  f = e + 5 }
run { a = x + 1  b = y * 2  c = b + 1 }
run { a = x * 3  b = 4  c = b + y  d = c }
run { e = y + x  f = 2  e = f + 1 }
